label: 河流架桥
description: 分析单张网格中河流的局部流向，在垂直于流向的位置生成桥掩码。直线桥用投影法，折线桥用连连看算法连接两侧河岸端点（最多2次H/V转弯）。输入/输出都是单张 grid（item），网格列表由引擎按 DataTree 自动逐张 fanout。
description-en: Analyzes the local river flow direction in a single grid and generates a bridge mask perpendicular to it. Straight mode uses projection; zigzag mode uses Shisen-Sho pathfinding (≤2 H/V turns) connecting opposite bank endpoints. Input/output are single grids (item); the engine fans out a DataTree of grids one-by-one.
icon: 俯视河流上一座横跨两岸的桥梁，细长矩形横穿蓝色水域，扁平插画风格，主色2种。

inputs.name: inputGrid
inputs.label: 河流网格
inputs.description: 单张二维网格（grid[y][x]）；非零值为河流区域，自动识别流向。网格列表由引擎按 DataTree 自动逐张 fanout。
inputs.description-en: A single 2D grid (grid[y][x]); non-zero cells define the river region and flow is auto-detected. The engine fans out a DataTree of grids one-by-one.

inputs.name: position
inputs.label: 桥位置
inputs.description: 0.0~1.0，沿河流主轴方向的相对位置，0=起点端，1=终点端，0.5=中央
inputs.description-en: 0.0 to 1.0, relative position along the river's main axis. 0=start, 1=end, 0.5=center.

inputs.name: algorithm
inputs.label: 桥形算法
inputs.description: straight=直线桥；zigzag=水平竖直折线桥（Z形/L形）
inputs.description-en: straight = straight perpendicular bridge; zigzag = H/V polyline bridge (Z or L shape).

inputs.name: extendToLand
inputs.label: 延伸到陆地
inputs.description: 开启后桥的两端落点各延伸1格到河岸外的陆地，使桥真正连接两岸
inputs.description-en: When enabled, the bridge extends 1 cell beyond each river bank onto land, connecting both shores.

outputs.name: outputGrid
outputs.label: 桥掩码
outputs.description: 桥掩码网格，桥格值为 1，其余为 0；输入为网格列表时引擎逐张产出对应的 DataTree。
outputs.description-en: Bridge mask grid; bridge cells = 1, others = 0. With a grid-list input the engine emits one per branch as a DataTree.

outputs.name: outputNameList
outputs.label: 名称清单
outputs.description: 名称清单，固定 [{id: 1, name: '桥', type: 'tile'}]
